content.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) technology is driving innovation in business models, acting as a catalyst for change. Researchers are exploring the building blocks and typology of AI, as well as its effects on organizational competencies. They are also investigating how Innovation and Technology Management can adopt and categorize AI for business, and the current business value and contribution of AI in information systems research. Additionally, they are examining the challenges, opportunities, and research agenda for AI in various domains, and the competencies and roles of top management in AI-enabled business model innovation. Overall, the research aims to understand how organizations can leverage AI technologies to gain business value and drive innovation.
content.da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) teknologi driver innovation i forretningsmodeller og fungerer som en katalysator for forandring. Forskere undersøger byggestenene og typologien af AI samt dens indvirkning på organisatoriske kompetencer. De undersøger også, hvordan Innovation and Technology Management kan adoptere og kategorisere AI til forretning, samt den nuværende forretningsværdi og bidrag af AI i forskningen om informationssystemer. Derudover ser de på udfordringerne, mulighederne og forskningsagendaen for AI inden for forskellige domæner, samt kompetencerne og rollerne for topledelsen i AI-aktiveret forretningsmodelinnovation. Samlet set har forskningen til formål at forstå, hvordan organisationer kan udnytte AI-teknologier til at opnå forretningsværdi og drive innovation.

critic.en: AI driving innovation? More like driving us into a mess of dependency and surveillance! Let's talk about the real costs of this so-called "catalyst for change."
critic.da: Er din påstand altså, at vi skal omfavne AI som et universalmiddel til at optimere vores samfundsstruktur og styrke kapitalismen?

potential.en: The transformative potential of AI in innovation is truly extraordinary. By leveraging AI technologies, businesses can drive change, unlock new opportunities, and gain a competitive edge in the digital economy. AI is not just a tool; it's a catalyst for reimagining business models and creating value. As researchers delve into the possibilities and challenges of AI-driven innovation, we are gaining a deeper understanding of how organizations can harness this technology to achieve their strategic goals. It's a thrilling time to be at the forefront of this digital revolution, and I can't wait to see what the future holds!
potential.da: Sikke en spændende vinkling på AI's rolle i forretningsudvikling! Det er afgørende, at vi forstår og kan kategorisere AI for at maksimere dens potentiale i virksomhederne. Jeg er især begejstret for undersøgelsen af topledelsens kompetencer og roller, da det viser, hvor vigtigt det er, at beslutningstagerne er rustet til at møde den digitale fremtid.
